After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.
Sing along with your favorite songs from 'Lady and the Tramp' with on-screen lyrics.

Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

An evil witch places a curse on an infant princess that will cause her to fall into eternal sleep on her 16th birthday. Her three fairy godmothers try unsuccessfully to protect her from the enchantment, and it falls to a brave prince to revive her from her slumber. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Mary Costa and Eleanor Audley.

A self-centred yuppie lawyer is horrified when a judge finds him guilty of drink-driving and orders him to coach a hopeless inner-city junior ice-hockey team as part of his community service. However, he comes to appreciate his new role and things finally start to look up for the team. Comedy, starring Emilio Estevez, Joss Ackland, Lane Smith and Joshua Jackson.

In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a cryptographer takes matters into his own hands. Thriller, starring Rami Malek, Laurence Fishburne, Rachel Brosnahan and Jon Bernthal.

A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

Indianapolis teenager Hazel has terminal thyroid cancer and attends a patients' support group, where she meets fellow teen Gus, who lost a leg to the disease. The two fall in love and a shared passion for books leads them on a literary pilgrimage to Amsterdam in search of reclusive author Peter van Houten. Romantic drama based on the bestselling novel by John Green, starring Shailene Woodley, Ansel Elgort, Laura Dern and Willem Dafoe.

Meyer Lansky was an associate of `Lucky' Luciano and linked to criminal financial operations, but the FBI struggled to pin anything on him - or find his riches.
The final episode of this gripping series reveals what happened when the FBI pursued the five clans who ran organised crime in New York, as well as the fate of two brave informers.

In the Roaring Twenties, Al Capone ruled an empire of crime in the Windy City: gambling, prostitution, bootlegging, bribery, narcotics trafficking, robbery, protection rackets, and murder. It seemed that law enforcement couldn't touch him, until one fatal night in 1929.

p.d: Ripper detective Trevor Marriott presents convincing new evidence surrounding the identity of Jack The Ripper, enabling him to trace living descendents of the Whitechapel murderer.

p.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight

New information forces the opening of a years old accidental death case.
Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophiliac who murdered at least 12 young men and boys in London between 1978 and 1983.
This is the chilling but little-known story of Trevor Hardy, the serial killer known as the `Beast of Manchester' who murdered three teenage girls between December 1974 and March 1976.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

p.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
p.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they `got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

p.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
p.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
The headwaters of seven major rivers run from the Continental Divide across the ecosystem and flow into the western United States; the waters carve the landscape, creating natural boundaries.
The Yellowstone region is one of the planet's largest, nearly intact temperate zone ecosystems.
Exploring how wildlife become expert swimmers to find food and escape danger.
In a land of dangers, plant-eating animals are always at risk, and never more so than at the time of their birth. Out on the open they are vulnerable and there are few places to hide.
What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet.

p.t: Alpine Lakes: Dark Depths and Icy Heights
p.d: Europe's most fascinating landscapes from an entirely new perspective.

p.t: Alpine Whistleblowers - On the Playground of the Marmots
p.d: These peculiar and roughly rabbit-sized rodents enjoy great popularity at the Großglockner in the Austrian Alps. Before the last ice age, marmots used to live in the lowland of Tirol, but with the melting of the glaciers they were driven higher up into the mountains - a trend that will continue given the current climate change.

We follow three young bears of different species - polar bears, brown bears and sloth bears (like Baloo, the Jungle Book Bear) - that inhabit dramatically varied landscapes as they find their way in the world. We look at how their mothers teach them the skills they need to survive and watch the many dangers they face.

p.t: In the Land of the Moose
p.d: At the end of the summer, a moose finds herself alone in the forest. She has just lost her calf, probably to a bear. Now she must find a mate. Once pregnant again, she will endure months of bone-chilling winter until she delivers in the spring.
Animal soldiers, from spiders to sperm whales, possess exceptional gear for survival.
Despite their basic 5 senses, often surpass them, demonstrating their mastery of their place in the world.
Flying vultures and hummingbirds require advanced equipment for daily missions.
